result.topic_en: Transformation formulas for Gauss's theta-type functions p, q, r of complex arguments under (D+Bi)/A, followed by a numerical check of a value of p and r for M = arithmetic-geometric mean of 1 and 0.2 (via cot ψ), with a note relating complete elliptic integrals to p(t), q(t), r(t).
